recipes.name: Segmented control
recipes.notes: There is no .active class — the selected segment is the one carrying data-variant="primary" while its siblings stay ghost. Drive selection with aria-pressed and swap the variant when it changes.

recipes.name: Search input bar
recipes.markup: ⌕ ⌘K
recipes.notes: Provide an accessible label when no visible label is present. There is no .kbd class — a bare span carries the shortcut hint.

recipes.name: Responsive metrics grid
recipes.markup: 99.98% Availability
recipes.notes: Repeat the card child for each metric; grid-4 owns responsive column stepping. Card padding rides data-pad — cards have no data-size, and data-variant already paints the surface, so no .bg-* class is needed.

recipes.name: Profile action row
recipes.markup:
AV
Alex Vancealex@example.com
recipes.notes: There is no .avatar class — .chip carries the initials. Give the image meaningful alt text when it conveys information not already present in adjacent text.

recipes.name: Settings switch row
recipes.markup: Enable telemetryCollect anonymized traces.
recipes.notes: There is no switch-track / switch-thumb / .checked class — the system ships no switch component, so use a native checkbox inside .checkbox-wrapper. Partition borders are .bb and .bt, not .border-bottom.

recipes.name: Action dialog
recipes.markup:
Confirm action

Review this action before continuing.
recipes.notes: Use the native dialog API and return focus to the invoking control. There is no .dialog class and no .pad-0 (the ladder starts at .pad-xs) — put the padding on the inner regions instead.

recipes.name: Dropdown action menu
recipes.notes: There is no .popover or .open class — show and hide the panel with the native hidden attribute or a framework conditional. .xleft is a container modifier and does not apply to buttons; use .ta-l to align menu item text.

recipes.name: Application status bar
recipes.markup:

recipes.notes: Do not rely on color alone for connection state. There is no .square-6 class — .chip carries the state label.
